nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the primary focus of the New Silk Road (NSR) as discussed in the article?
nodes.answer: The primary focus of the NSR is to serve as China's globalization strategy aimed at greater economic openness through policy coordination, infrastructure connectivity, trade facilitation, financial cooperation, and people-to-people contacts.
nodes.paragraph: The analysis reveals the potentials and challenges of the NSR for local effects but also includes suggestions for transnational cooperation and govern- ance, which finally leads to defining the role of supranational institutions and the necessity of local support in terms of a governance design. Keywords Multi-level governance Belt and Road Initiative Globalization Local effects Local development Sustainable development 1 Introduction The New Silk Road (NSR) reflects China S globalization strategy (Carrai et al. 2020b) and the intention for a greater economic openness based on policy coordina- tion, infrastructure connectivity, trade facilitation, financial cooperation, and people- to-people contacts (Belt and Road Portal 2015). Although the initiative is partially successful, it requires further research on governance mechanisms for sustainable implementation.
